annualCoverage.note: The annual runner records 3,000 finite candidate rows but explicitly leaves independentHistoricalOracleVerified false for every random epoch.

trueLongitudeAudit.source: Burgess 1860 Sūrya-Siddhānta II.39–45; B.V. Raman Ch.VI §§99–107, pp.74–79.
trueLongitudeAudit.modernReference: NASA/JPL Horizons DE441 Earth-geocentric apparent ecliptic-of-date, quantity 31, explicit Saura frame transfer.
trueLongitudeAudit.note: 3,000 January annual checkpoints are modern numerical comparisons, not the 600 random DOB epochs or historical classical printed-table oracles.

sheeghroccheyaAudit.conflict: Saturn §104 table p.77: 151.23°; Example 49 p.78: 181.23°, yielding 63.42° Chesta Kendra and 21.14 Chesta Bala.
sheeghroccheyaAudit.limit: One worked example only; no complete 1800–2399 independent tabulation acquired.

independentEphemerisAcquisition.officialMetadata: IMD PAC identifies modern IAE reference epoch J2000.5 and ephemeris argument TT.
independentEphemerisAcquisition.note: Daily planetary table pages were not downloaded/transcribed; bibliographic existence is not numerical evidence.
